method: Read primary public pages and retained course material. Register distinguishes claims, dates, scope and gaps. No interview or survey research. Dynamic links are valid evidence as observed, not a guarantee of later availability.

sources.claim_or_number: Cost reduction, local responsiveness and international strategy/control framework.
sources.reference: Cengage Learning. (2017a). Control of global business [BUS219 lecture slides, Session 8]. Murdoch University LMS.
evidence: Materials/11 Topic 8_ Control of Global Business/Session8 chapter9.pptx
sources.limitation: Read course slide files, not the full textbook. No invented book page numbers.

sources.claim_or_number: Export, licensing, joint venture and ownership trade-offs.
sources.reference: Cengage Learning. (2017b). Entry strategies in global business [BUS219 lecture slides, Session 7]. Murdoch University LMS.
sources.status: read; exact live LMS resource ID confirmed
evidence: Materials/10 Topic 7_ Entry Strategies in Global Business/Session7 chapter8.pptx
sources.limitation: Course slides read; no claim to have read the complete textbook.

sources.claim_or_number: Advertised standard Amman delivery around 48 working hours; COD and card options.
sources.reference: Dumyah. (n.d.). Frequently asked questions.
sources.limitation: Merchant claims, not independent performance data; timings vary by service. Do not infer market share.

sources.claim_or_number: General sales-tax tables contain exceptions; standard residual rate 16%.
sources.reference: Income and Sales Tax Department. (n.d.). Tax rates [Arabic].
sources.evidence: Official Arabic tax-rates page explicitly states residual 16%, alongside 0%, 2%, 4%, 5%, 10% and exemptions.
sources.limitation: No SKU-specific tax opinion or claim that every service is taxed at 16%.

sources.claim_or_number: Commercial importer registration/card and import documents.
sources.reference: International Trade Administration. (2026b, February 26). Jordan: Import requirements and documentation.
sources.limitation: Guide includes US-specific export documents; those details are not transplanted to UAE exports. Confirm local importer and customs procedure.

sources.claim_or_number: Page quotes 10% with minimum JOD 5 for low-value personal parcels.
sources.reference: International Trade Administration. (2026a, February 26). Jordan: eCommerce.
sources.limitation: Conflicts with current Jordan Customs FAQ stating 16%; not used as current project tax input. Personal parcels are not commercial imports.

sources.claim_or_number: 2.81 million mobile-wallet users in 2025.
sources.reference: JoPACC. (2026, March 29). JoPACC releases its 2025 payments systems report.
sources.limitation: Payment users are not a count of online shoppers or noon customers. No conversion to market size.

sources.claim_or_number: Arabic FAQ states 16% for personal postal parcels with value below JOD 200.
sources.reference: Jordan Customs. (n.d.). Frequently asked questions [Arabic].
sources.limitation: Scope limited to qualifying personal parcels. Commercial rate depends on classification and origin. Conflict with ITA retained openly.

sources.claim_or_number: 96.5% of households had internet access in 2024; survey covers 8,270 households.
sources.reference: Ministry of Digital Economy and Entrepreneurship. (n.d.-b). Summary of the survey on ICT access and use in households and by individuals 2024.
sources.evidence: PDF pp. 2 and 6; chart shows 2024 96.5% versus 2023 91.2%.
sources.limitation: Households, not individuals, purchasers, or order demand. Survey sample is not market size.

sources.claim_or_number: Personal Data Protection Law effective 17 March 2024; processing and transfer checks required.
sources.reference: Ministry of Digital Economy and Entrepreneurship. (n.d.-a). Personal data protection: FAQs.
sources.limitation: FAQ is guidance, not an entity-specific legal assessment. Official bilingual law was also read, including Article 15 on overseas transfers.

sources.claim_or_number: Official register lists Investment Environment Regulation No. 7 of 2023 and a regulation with amendments.
sources.reference: Ministry of Investment. (n.d.). Regulations [Register of the Investment Environment Regulation and amendments].
sources.status: register read; operative text not fully verified
sources.limitation: Register readable via web tool. Consolidated PDF not obtained; direct request returned 451. No current foreign ownership percentage is asserted.

sources.claim_or_number: Cabinet announcement of amendments to investment-environment regulation.
sources.reference: Ministry of Investment. (2026, May 17). Cabinet approves amended investment environment regulation 2026.
sources.limitation: Announcement describes licensing/incentive reforms; it does not establish a particular JV ownership entitlement or a tax holiday for this project.

sources.claim_or_number: Existing cross-border merchant programme extends UAE operations to four Gulf destinations; logistics/customs requirements exist.
sources.reference: noon. (n.d.-a). Cross-border selling [Seller guidance].
sources.geography: UAE, Bahrain, Kuwait, Oman, Qatar; separate KSA lane
sources.limitation: GCC programme is evidence of capability, not permission, price quote or process applicable to Jordan.

sources.claim_or_number: UAE seller fee page includes 15% historical home-category referral fees and differentiated current/old September 2026 tables.
sources.reference: noon. (n.d.-c). Fulfilled by partner (FBP) fees in UAE.
sources.limitation: 15% is a scenario benchmark, not a Jordan quote. Tax base, merchant contract and category schedule must be agreed; no outdated fee claimed as universal current rate.

sources.claim_or_number: noon.com commercial journey described as starting in 2017; mission concerns buying and selling.
sources.reference: noon. (n.d.-d). noon Next: Dream bigger. Achieve more.
sources.limitation: Self-description; promotional claims of scale/leadership omitted. Founding announcement is 2016, launch 2017.

sources.claim_or_number: Delivery options page identifies KSA, UAE and Egypt for its core services; read alongside the additional GCC cross-border programme.
sources.reference: noon. (n.d.-b). Delivery options.
sources.limitation: Read alongside expanded seller cross-border page. Absence of Jordan from lists is not definitive proof of no retail activity or no group service.

sources.claim_or_number: Privacy policy identifies Noon E-Commerce owned by Noon AD Holdings One Person Company, a Dubai LLC.
sources.reference: noon. (2026, February). Privacy policy.
sources.limitation: Operating entity is not the current group cap table or confirmed Jordan contracting entity.

sources.claim_or_number: Supported merchant countries include Jordan.
sources.reference: noon Payments. (n.d.). Frequently asked questions.
sources.status: official indexed page text read; dynamic page body limited
sources.limitation: Payment acceptance services differ from noon retail delivery. Does not demonstrate a Jordan retail marketplace launch.

sources.claim_or_number: Tool attribution: Codex used in preparing the report.
sources.reference: OpenAI. (n.d.). Codex [Generative AI assistant]. Used in preparing this report; see the preparation disclosure.
sources.status: tool attribution; not used as a factual research source
sources.limitation: Actual workflow attribution, not a source for market facts.

sources.claim_or_number: 2016 venture announcement identified PIF 50% equity and Mohamed Alabbar.
sources.reference: Public Investment Fund. (2016, November 13). PIF: 50% equity [noon launch announcement].
sources.limitation: Historical ownership only; current dilution/capitalisation not verified.

sources.claim_or_number: Jordan shopping/shipping destination exists.
sources.reference: SHEIN. (n.d.). Shipping information: Jordan.
sources.limitation: Displayed delivery windows depend on session/date. No current exact shipping price or delivered-performance claim used.

sources.claim_or_number: International strategy should be justified through cost pressure and local responsiveness.
sources.reference: Walia, N. (2026, October 13). International strategy and the group report [BUS219 class explanation; local lecture notes]. Murdoch University Dubai.
sources.limitation: Local notes/transcript of class explanation, not an invented direct quote. Recording segment noted in course HISTORY.

sources.claim_or_number: Consumer Protection Law No. 7 of 2017 exists; accurate information and redress are relevant.
sources.reference: WIPO. (2017). Consumer Protection Law No. 7 of 2017: Jordan [WIPO Lex record].
sources.limitation: WIPO record establishes legal source. UNEP/FAO abstract separately reviewed for scope; no invented cooling-off period.

sources.claim_or_number: 2025 growth estimate 2.8%; unemployment 21.4% in Q3 2025; regional disruption risks.
sources.reference: World Bank. (n.d.). Jordan overview.
sources.limitation: Growth is an estimate and unemployment is a dated national measure; neither predicts category demand. Old poverty statistic deliberately excluded.

sources.claim_or_number: Poster National article exists: noon plans Syria operations.
sources.reference: Jain, S. (2026, May 17). Alabbar’s noon plans to launch operations in Syria. The National.
sources.limitation: Plans are not proof of retail launch; does not establish Jordan entry.

sources.claim_or_number: Poster Wamda funding article exists, reporting USD 500 million.
sources.reference: Wamda. (2025, December 15). noon raises $500 million from PIF-backed investors ahead of potential IPO.
sources.limitation: Secondary report with anonymous sourcing; no inference about cash committed to Jordan or current ownership percentages.

sources.claim_or_number: Poster ITA Jordan ICT 2026 publication exists.
sources.reference: International Trade Administration. (2026, February 26). Jordan: Information and communication technology.
sources.limitation: Sector opportunity description is not consumer e-commerce demand.

sources.claim_or_number: IPC publicly describes cross-border shopper research.
sources.reference: International Post Corporation. (n.d.). Cross-border e-commerce shopper survey.
sources.limitation: The poster’s joint Statista/IPC citation lacks an identifiable item/metric. Global results cannot be assigned to Jordan.

sources.claim_or_number: Hill international-business textbook exists; poster edition/year absent.
sources.reference: McGraw Hill. (n.d.). International business: Competing in the global marketplace.
sources.status: catalogue read, full book not read
sources.limitation: No edition, quotation or page number invented. The report uses supplied course slides instead.
